Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value From assays Join activities On assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id Join molecule_dictionary On activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno Left Join compound_structures On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno Where activities.standard_relation = '=' And activities.pchembl_value Is Not Null And activities.bao_endpoint = 'IC50' And assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' And target_dictionary.tid = 1938222 And target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' And activities.activity_id Is Not Null And activities.activity_id In (Select activity_id From activities Join assays On activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id Join target_dictionary On assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid Where target_dictionary.tid = 1938222 And target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' And activities.standard_relation = '=' And activities.pchembl_value Is Not Null And activities.bao_endpoint = 'IC50' Limit 1000 Order By molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id
